scientific_integrity: Analytic proof supplied; exact-rational diagnostics are supplementary, not exhaustive; literature priority remains conditional on accessible sources.
scientific_limitations: Applies to exact two-operator splitting with bounded linear generators and fixed finite terminal time.
The odd-radix lower bound is an explicit nonnormal three-dimensional problem along a sparse step-count subsequence.
The all-even-radix result does not extend automatically to three or more split operators or nonlinear PDEs.
title: The radix-parity boundary for quasi-random Lie splitting
